data.name: Digital Darkness
data.detailed_description:
Control a vessel from a first-person perspective. They have thoughts and had a life of their own. Give them power through fate so they may have a chance to change something. They have one true goal. Make sure it is completed. That is all...
----

Digital Darkness is a semi-linear, story driven game with a first-person tactile combat system. Use a variety of weapons and abilities to overcome opposition as you make your way high up toward the Clock Tower, in hopes of changing the timeline to create a different future.

The Veyora Corporation controls the city. They seek to keep order and balance by any means necessary against a growing darkness. The only thing that matters is reaching the Clock Tower and to try and change the timeline by pulling back the chains of time.

====Game Features====

// Fight for a different future // Wield the fragments of memories and emotions past // The City is a vast semi-linear world // Many stories have been chosen to be ignored, forgotten, or rewritten

-Engage enemies in a First-Person Tactile Combat system. Block and take cover with Physical Weapons to generate more Ammo and Core Energy. Use Long Range Weapons that use Ammo to finish off or start Engagements with. Use your Abilities that use Core Energy or the objects in the environment to sway a fight in your favor.


-Wield the 7 Elements of memories and emotions through Fragments to create unique Elemental Builds by combining Abilities, Weapons. and Fragments.

-Uncover the dark secrets and past of the City that has been suppressed and rewritten.

-Semi-Linear. As you progress through the Main Story you will unlock new Sectors of the City. Each Sector contains quests, puzzles, secrets, and blueprints for more Weapons and Abilities.

-Branched Storyline. Certain Decisions matter and will affect the trajectory of your main story with a few different endings.

-Defeat the high ranking members of the Veyora corporation that have control over the city.

----
You may encounter some unsightly opposition, emotionally stressed individuals, and those with high values. Ignore them, and make sure the vessel completes the goal.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: Characters you fight and your character will bleed. Most combat encounters will depict blood. There are some elements of psychological horror and some enemies may have a disturbing appearance.
